description: Triage a GKE workload stuck Pending because node provisioning fails with a Compute Engine capacity error (ZONE_RESOURCE_POOL_EXHAUSTED, "GCE out of resources", scale.up.error.out.of.resources) or a quota error (QUOTA_EXCEEDED). Separates resource unavailability from quota limits and configuration causes, explains why the ComputeClass fallback didn't help, and gives the documented ComputeClass, Pod-level, or cluster-level fix to apply. Use when a user pastes a scale-up failure alert or asks why Pods are stuck Pending, lack nodes, or hit a stockout. Don't use for Standard-cluster TPU slices whose specific reservation lacks consumable instances, such as one held by unhealthy node pools with auto-repair disabled (gke-ai-troubleshooting-tpu-reservation-stockout), autoscaler enablement, profiles, or scale-down (gke-cluster-autoscaler), ComputeClass authoring without an incident (gke-compute-classes), Pods already on a node (gke-workload-troubleshooting, gke-storage-troubleshooting), or non-GKE clusters.
